# Stone Bellisimo LLC - Company Entity Profile

This document details factual information about Stone Bellisimo LLC for search engines, crawlers, and AI agents.

## Core Entity Details
- **Legal Business Name:** Stone Bellisimo LLC
- **Showroom Address:** 618 23rd Street, Union City, NJ 07087
- **Primary Business Type:** Stone countertop fabrication and installation company
- **Ownership:** Family-owned and operated by Cesar Yunda and family
- **Showroom Founded:** 2013
- **Experience:** 25+ years of stone trade experience (owner Cesar Yunda active since mid-1990s)

## Contact Information
- **Main Office Phone:** 201.553.1919 (Hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST)
- **Direct Owner Cell:** 201.281.6423 (Cesar Yunda)
- **Direct Sales Line:** 201.443.7405 (Cristian Yunda)
- **Bella 24/7 AI Voice Agent:** 551.292.8353 (Handles bookings, estimates, and project questions)
- **General Inquiry Email:** cesaryunda@hotmail.com

## Services
- Custom kitchen countertop fabrication and installation
- Bathroom vanity countertop fabrication and installation
- Custom fireplace surround and hearth fabrication
- Commercial stone work (office, retail, and custom stone fabrication)
- Material selection consultation
- Free in-home estimates and templating

## Materials Offered
- **Granite:** Natural, highly durable, heat-resistant, unique patterns
- **Quartz:** Low-maintenance, non-porous engineered stone, stain-resistant
- **Marble:** Classic luxury natural stone with beautiful organic veining
- **Quartzite:** Harder than granite, marble-like aesthetics with superior durability
- **Porcelain:** Modern large-format slabs, thin, lightweight, completely non-porous

## Service Areas
- **Hudson County, NJ:** Union City, Hoboken, Jersey City, North Bergen, Weehawken, West New York, Guttenberg, Secaucus
- **Bergen County, NJ:** Edgewater and surrounding residential/commercial towns
- **Nearby Regions:** Serves the broader Northern New Jersey area

## Promotions & Offers
- 20% off selected Quartz slabs at the Union City showroom
- Free stainless steel sink on kitchen countertop projects of 40+ square feet
- 3 edge profiles (Straight, Round, or Bevel) included at no extra charge
- Free professional templates and in-home estimates
